items.title: Bill Allred interviewed by Monk Rowe, Orlando, Florida, February 24, 2017
items.q: The interviewee mentions Woody only in the context of his son John's career ('John at that point, he’d been on the road with Woody', 'When I first started with Woody', 'was out with Woody'). There is no evidence of a direct personal or professional relationship between Bill Allred and Woody.

ctx.x: They scheduled me and him to do a tune, two tunes together with a rhythm section at this Colorado Springs. And the guy that booked that was famous for that, putting you on the spot you know. Because he did that to me with Carl, with Watrous and — I never played with Rossolino — but anyway he did that so Watrous, he gets up on the stand and I said, “Bill, what a pleasure man, I’ve enjoyed your work for years.” And he said, “Well I caught you on the last set,” he said, “you sounded good.” He said, “Let’s play some…
Do you guys ever — I can just picture this scenario where your son calls you up and says, “Hey guess what I’m doing?” And you say, “Oh yeah, well guess what I’m doing.” Like one upsmanship.
